functions.name: cancel-recording-upload
functions.description: Abort a pending beta recording upload and discard its stored parts. This does not delete an already imported meeting.

uploadId.description: Opaque pending upload session ID whose stored parts should be discarded.

FunctionInput_tldv_cancelrecordingupload.description: Identify the pending recording upload to cancel.

canceled.description: True when the abort operation succeeded, including already aborted or expired no-op cases; does not prove this call newly removed parts.

uploadId.description: Upload session for which cancellation or the documented no-op was accepted.

FunctionOutput_tldv_cancelrecordinguploa.description: Accepted cancellation or documented no-op for the requested recording upload.

tags.instructions: Use the ID from `create-recording-upload`. Cancellation drops stored parts and is not a way to delete a completed meeting. Already aborted or expired uploads are a no-op; completed uploads cannot be canceled. Use `get-recording-upload` to inspect a session or `complete-recording-upload` to finish it. You must start a new session to upload again after cancellation.

functions.name: complete-recording-upload
functions.description: Assemble an uploaded recording and obtain its asynchronous import job ID. All planned parts must already be stored.

uploadId.description: Opaque upload session ID whose full part plan has been transferred to storage.

FunctionInput_tldv_completerecordinguplo.description: The fully transferred recording upload session to complete.

jobId.description: Opaque import job ID; repeated successful completion returns the same ID. This is not a meeting ID.

message.description: Provider's human-readable completion message when supplied.

success.description: Provider-reported completion request result, not completion of import processing.

uploadId.description: Upload session whose completion was requested.

FunctionOutput_tldv_completerecordingupl.description: Immediate completion acknowledgement and asynchronous import job reference.

tags.instructions: After your application has transferred every part from `create-recording-upload`, use this to complete the session. Use `get-recording-upload` to find missing parts or refresh URLs, and complete before expiresAt. This returns a job reference, not a ready meeting or transcript. The provider permits retrying completion: an already completed upload returns the same job ID. Use `cancel-recording-upload` instead to discard an unfinished session.

functions.name: create-recording-upload
functions.description: Create a beta recording-upload session and obtain the signed part plan for a file up to 2 GiB. This prepares the upload; it does not transfer file bytes or wait for processing.

name.description: Title for the meeting created from the recording.

fileName.description: Original file name retained only for reference; does not transfer the file.

metadata.description: Flat correlation map with at most 20 keys and scalar values, stored verbatim; {} remains empty and omission leaves it unspecified.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte length of the source file, at most 2 GiB; each planned part must contain exactly its declared byte count.

happenedAt.description: Meeting occurrence instant with explicit offset; omitted uses the provider's current date/time.

contentType.description: Known media MIME type in the video or audio family, or application/octet-stream. Omit when unknown.

phoneNumber.description: Associated phone number preserved verbatim, including formatting.

participants.description: Email addresses of invited participants; omitted is unspecified and [] explicitly supplies none.

FunctionInput_tldv_createrecordingupload.description: Meeting details and exact file declaration for a recording-upload session; no file bytes.

id.description: Opaque recording-upload session ID used as uploadId by related tools.

jobId.description: Opaque import job ID when supplied; distinct from upload and meeting IDs.

url.description: Sensitive signed URL for this part's byte transfer, when supplied; preserve exactly and do not attach the API key.

uploaded.description: Whether storage already holds this part.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte count to send for this part, taken from size.

startByte.description: Zero-based first byte offset, provisionally mapped from byteRange.start; see validation assumption.

partNumber.description: Provider-assigned part number; do not renumber it.

urlExpiresAt.description: Signed part URL expiry normalized to UTC Z; omitted when no URL is supplied.

items.description: One provider-issued part and its exact source byte span.

parts.description: Provider-issued part plan; used for exact byte transfer by the caller's application.

status.description: Provider-native upload status, such as Pending; not a processing-completion guarantee.

expiresAt.description: Deadline for completing this upload, normalized to UTC Z without fractional rounding.

partCount.description: Number of parts in the provider plan.

sizeBytes.description: Total declared file size in bytes.

partSizeBytes.description: Provider's nominal part size in bytes; individual parts may differ.

FunctionOutput_tldv_createrecordinguploa.description: Created recording-upload session and signed part plan; file bytes have not been transferred.

tags.instructions: Requires upload beta access from tl;dv support. Use when the recording is in your own system; use `import-meeting` for an existing public media URL. Supply the exact file size. Your application must send each planned byte range to its signed URL, then call `complete-recording-upload`. Use `get-recording-upload` to resume or refresh expired part URLs, or `cancel-recording-upload` to discard the session. Finish before expiresAt. Never send the API key to signed storage URLs.

functions.name: get-api-health
functions.description: Check whether the tl;dv API responds successfully to its health check.

FunctionInput_tldv_getapihealth.description: No parameters are needed to check API availability.

healthy.description: True when the provider health endpoint returned its documented successful response; not a guarantee about all API features.

FunctionOutput_tldv_getapihealth.description: The result of a successful tl;dv API health check.

tags.instructions: Use this for a quick API availability check. Success does not establish that a particular meeting is accessible; use `get-meeting` for that.

functions.name: get-meeting
functions.description: Get an accessible meeting's details and correlation metadata by its ID.

meetingId.description: Opaque meeting ID returned by list-meetings; not a meeting-page URL.

FunctionInput_tldv_getmeeting.description: Identify one accessible meeting by its opaque ID.

url.description: Meeting-page URL, not a recording download link.

duration.description: Provider-native duration value with undocumented units; not assumed to be seconds or milliseconds.

invitees.description: Invited people in provider order; empty remains empty.

email.description: Person's email address as returned, when supplied.

items.description: A person associated with the meeting.

metadata.description: Correlation metadata with scalar values preserved without coercion.

organizer.description: Meeting organizer whose plan may govern programmatic access.

email.description: Person's email address as returned, when supplied.

happenedAt.description: Meeting occurrence instant normalized to UTC Z, preserving fractional precision; omitted if absent.

conferenceId.description: Conference identifier, when supplied in extra properties.

FunctionOutput_tldv_getmeeting.description: Meeting details and correlation metadata, returned directly without a response envelope.

tags.instructions: Obtain an ID from `list-meetings`, then use this for meeting metadata. Use `get-meeting-transcript` or `get-meeting-notes` for content, or `get-meeting-recording-download-url` for a recording link. UI sharing alone does not guarantee API access.

functions.name: get-meeting-highlights
functions.description: Get a meeting's legacy highlights, including source and topic information. This endpoint is deprecated; prefer current meeting notes.

meetingId.description: Opaque meeting ID whose legacy highlights are requested.

FunctionInput_tldv_getmeetinghighlights.description: Meeting whose legacy highlights are requested.

text.description: Highlight text as ordinary Unicode text.

source.description: Provider source value such as manual, preserved without assuming a closed set.

startPosition.description: Provider-native numeric startTime with undocumented units; not an instant.

items.description: A legacy highlight with available source, topic, text, and position information.
Legacy highlight entries in provider order.

meetingId.description: Meeting identifier returned with these highlights.

FunctionOutput_tldv_getmeetinghighlights.description: Available legacy highlights and their meeting identifier.

tags.instructions: Use this only when legacy highlight source or topic data is specifically needed. Prefer `get-meeting-notes` for current notes. Obtain meetingId from `list-meetings`. Highlights are available only after the transcript is complete; this call does not wait. Numeric positions have undocumented units.

functions.name: get-meeting-notes
functions.description: Get a meeting's structured notes, Markdown content, and ordered topics.

meetingId.description: Opaque meeting identifier whose notes are requested.

FunctionInput_tldv_getmeetingnotes.description: Identify the meeting whose notes are requested.

topics.description: Topic records in returned order, retaining the provider's explicit order values.

order.description: Provider-defined topic ordering value, copied without renumbering.

meetingId.description: Meeting identifier to which these notes belong.

markdownContent.description: Notes in Markdown as ordinary text; no transport decoding is required by the caller.

structuredNotes.description: Structured note entries in provider order.

text.description: Note text as ordinary Unicode text.

topicId.description: Opaque reference to a topic in the topics collection when supplied.

position.description: Numeric provider timestamp position with undocumented units; not a wall-clock instant.

segmentId.description: Opaque segment identifier supplied by the provider.

FunctionOutput_tldv_getmeetingnotes.description: Meeting notes with structured entries, Markdown content, and topics when supplied.

tags.instructions: Use an ID from `list-meetings`. Prefer this over `get-meeting-highlights` for current notes. Use `get-meeting-transcript` for verbatim speaker-attributed content. This does not wait for note generation. Note positions are provider-native numbers with undocumented units.

functions.name: get-meeting-transcript
functions.description: Get a meeting's completed transcript as ordered speaker-attributed segments.

meetingId.description: Opaque meeting ID whose completed transcript is requested.

FunctionInput_tldv_getmeetingtranscript.description: Identify the meeting whose completed transcript is requested.

id.description: Opaque transcript identifier, distinct from the meeting identifier.

meetingId.description: Opaque meeting identifier to which this transcript belongs.

text.description: Transcript text preserved as ordinary Unicode text.

speaker.description: Provider's speaker label as ordinary text, not necessarily a user ID.

endPosition.description: Provider-native numeric endTime position in the same undocumented units as startPosition; not a wall-clock instant.

startPosition.description: Provider-native numeric startTime position; units are undocumented, so no seconds or milliseconds interpretation is promised.

items.description: One speaker-attributed transcript segment in provider order.

segments.description: Transcript segments in provider order; empty remains empty.

FunctionOutput_tldv_getmeetingtranscript.description: A completed meeting transcript with ordered segments and provider-native numeric positions.

tags.instructions: Use an ID from `list-meetings`. This returns only a completed transcript and does not wait for transcription. Use `get-meeting-notes` for summarized notes. Segment positions retain the provider's numeric values because their units are undocumented; do not treat them as wall-clock timestamps.

functions.name: get-recording-upload
functions.description: Get a beta recording upload's status and part plan, including fresh signed URLs for missing parts.

uploadId.description: Opaque recording-upload session ID returned as id by create-recording-upload.

FunctionInput_tldv_getrecordingupload.description: Recording-upload session to inspect for progress and a refreshed part plan.

jobId.description: Opaque import job ID, not a meeting ID; may be present even while pending.

url.description: Sensitive signed URL for uploading this part when supplied, normally for a missing part; never attach the API key.

uploaded.description: True when storage already holds this part.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte count for this part from the provider's size value.

startByte.description: Zero-based starting byte offset, provisionally mapped from byteRange.start.

urlExpiresAt.description: Signed URL expiry normalized to UTC Z; omitted if absent.

items.description: One provider-planned part with its storage presence and optional signed upload URL.

parts.description: Part plan with storage-presence flags and fresh URLs for missing parts.

status.description: Provider-native status such as Pending or Completed; no exhaustive state set is assumed.

expiresAt.description: Upload completion deadline in UTC Z, retaining fractional precision.

partCount.description: Provider's number of planned parts when supplied.

partSizeBytes.description: Nominal part size in bytes when supplied.

FunctionOutput_tldv_getrecordingupload.description: Current recording-upload status and part plan; this does not indicate import processing completion.

tags.instructions: Use the ID returned by `create-recording-upload` to inspect progress or resume after an interruption or URL expiry. Transfer only missing parts using the refreshed plan, then call `complete-recording-upload`; use `cancel-recording-upload` to discard the session. Finish before expiresAt. This reads storage status and does not transfer bytes or wait for import processing.

functions.name: import-meeting
functions.description: Submit a publicly accessible media URL for asynchronous meeting import, or validate the request without persisting it using dryRun.

url.description: Publicly accessible media URL. Supported formats are mp3, mp4, wav, m4a, mkv, mov, avi, wma and flac; signed URLs must remain accessible for provider processing.

name.description: Title of the imported meeting or recording, as ordinary Unicode text.

dryRun.description: True validates without persistence or processing; false submits a real import.

metadata.description: Flat correlation map with at most 20 keys; string values are at most 256 characters and scalar types are preserved. Omit for unspecified metadata; {} is an explicitly empty map.

propertyNames.description: Correlation key containing 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

anyOf.description: Correlation text of at most 256 characters.
Numeric correlation value, preserved without string conversion.
Boolean correlation value, preserved without string conversion.

happenedAt.description: Meeting occurrence instant with an explicit UTC marker or numeric offset; omitted uses the provider's current date/time.

phoneNumber.description: Associated phone number stored verbatim, including formatting; omitted leaves it unspecified.

participants.description: Email addresses of invited participants; omitted leaves them unspecified and [] explicitly supplies none.

FunctionInput_tldv_importmeeting.description: Public media URL and optional meeting details for import or validation.

jobId.description: Opaque import job identifier when supplied; not a meeting ID and may be absent for a dry run.

message.description: Provider's human-readable result message when supplied.

success.description: Provider-reported request success, not completion of media processing or transcript availability.

FunctionOutput_tldv_importmeeting.description: Immediate import submission or dry-run result, without waiting for media processing.

tags.instructions: Use this when the media already has a publicly accessible URL. It submits an import and does not wait for processing. Supported media: mp3, mp4, wav, m4a, mkv, mov, avi, wma and flac. Set dryRun to test without creating a meeting. Do not blindly repeat a real submission: duplicate imports are possible. Use `create-recording-upload` for a resumable upload from your own system.

functions.name: list-meetings
functions.description: List one page of accessible meetings, optionally narrowed by a text query, meeting date, participation, or internal/external meeting type.

to.description: Upper meeting-date filter as an RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset; must not precede from. Endpoint inclusivity is provider-defined.

from.description: Lower meeting-date filter as an RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset; endpoint inclusivity is provider-defined.

limit.description: Maximum meetings in one returned provider page. Keep unchanged while using a cursor.

query.description: Provider text search query; omitted means no text filter. Matching fields and syntax are provider-defined.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool for the same connection, filters, and limit; omit for the first page.

meetingType.description: Internal means all participants belong to the same organization; external means at least one belongs to another organization. Omit to include both.

onlyParticipated.description: If true, return only meetings in which the connected user participated; false does not impose that restriction.

FunctionInput_tldv_listmeetings.description: Filters and continuation for one page of accessible meetings. Limit defaults to 50; onlyParticipated defaults to false.

id.description: Opaque meeting identifier used by meeting-content tools.

url.description: Provider meeting-page URL; not a recording download URL.

duration.description: Provider-native duration value. Its unit is not documented; do not interpret it as seconds or milliseconds.

invitees.description: Invited people, preserving provider order and empty arrays.

email.description: Email address as returned by the provider, when supplied.

items.description: A person associated with the meeting.

metadata.description: Caller correlation metadata, preserving key names and scalar value types.

additionalProperties.description: A correlation value, retaining its string, number, or boolean type.

template.description: Provider's meeting template value, without interpreting its opaque meaning.

organizer.description: Meeting organizer, whose plan can determine API export access.

email.description: Email address as returned by the provider, when supplied.

happenedAt.description: Instant the meeting occurred, normalized to UTC with Z without rounding fractional seconds; omitted when absent.

phoneNumber.description: Associated phone number preserved verbatim, without normalization.

conferenceId.description: Conference identifier from the provider's extra properties, when present.

items.description: An accessible meeting with provider-supplied details.
Meetings in this provider page, in provider order; may be empty.

total.description: Provider-reported total matching meetings, subject to its 10,000-result ceiling; omitted if unavailable, not computed from this page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the next provider page; omitted when page metadata says the collection is exhausted.

FunctionOutput_tldv_listmeetings.description: One provider page of accessible meetings and its continuation, when available.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover meeting IDs or browse meetings. Use `get-meeting` for a known ID, and `get-meeting-transcript` or `get-meeting-notes` for content. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with identical filters and limit. Limit defaults to 50 and must be 1–100. Results are subject to the provider's 10,000-result cap; narrow the date range when necessary. UI sharing alone does not guarantee API access.
